dispositions.notes: completion-audit (delivery gate) blocks exactly what ca_classify_command calls delivery, in the payload's event format; the planning/protected-file gates allow strict jq installs/probes and read-only commands, and fail closed otherwise, so Skill calls stay denied by forbidden-skill-check/uat-gate until jq is installed (they cannot evaluate skills). Read-only detection reuses sb_shell_command_looks_read_only and delivery reuses ca_classify_command, so hardening by R1-12 applies to both paths.
